name: α: Train Student-t, Infer Gaussian
theory: Investigation 1: 80% of 108a improvement from weight regularization, not inference noise. Student-t at inference hurts CI slightly. Cross-swap estimated CI 92.7% with Gaussian inference.
prediction: CI 92.0% → ~92.7%. Kurtosis preserved. KS may recover 1-2 cells.
implementation: Load 108a checkpoint, override noise_dist to gaussian at sample time. Re-run test suite.
info_value: LOW but FREE — no training, 10 min

name: η: Freeze noise_skip_proj at ep10
theory: Investigation 10: ep10 sweet spot is natural two-phase dynamics. noise_skip_proj alignment causes correlation drift. MLP output rank 24.44 at ALL epochs. Freezing skip specifically should lock GT-level correlation permanently.
prediction: Cross-cell corr stays near 0.32 (GT 0.38) instead of drifting to 0.44+.
implementation: Add --freeze_skip_after_epoch 10 flag. Freeze noise_skip_proj while keeping cell_spread trainable.
info_value: HIGH — most targeted intervention for correlation

name: γ: One-Shot Conv3D with 3-Factor Noise Constraint
theory: Investigation 2: 111b Conv3D produces ensemble rank 7.46 (GT 2.48). Constraining noise to 3 dims via Linear(3,32) bottleneck should match GT factor structure.
prediction: Ensemble rank 7.46 → ~2.5. Kurtosis may improve from correlation-induced leptokurtosis.
implementation: Sample z~N(0,I_3), project through Linear(3,32) before NoiseMLP. One new layer.
info_value: HIGH — direct test of rank constraint

name: β: AR rho=0.5 + Condition-Dependent Offset
theory: Investigation 7: MLP Jacobian=-0.74 (mean-reverting!) but rho=0.8 overwhelms 7.2x. Investigation 4: learned rho physically correct. Investigation 9: encoder already provides 62% regime differentiation. Fix: base rho=0.5 + learned offset ±0.2.
prediction: ACF shifts toward GT. VR improves. Growing uncertainty passes (rho≥0.3).
implementation: ar_frame_rho=0.5, rho_offset_head: Linear(128→1), clamp total rho to [0.3, 0.7].

name: ε: Hybrid AR + One-Shot Ensemble
theory: AR has kurtosis/KS, one-shot has MR/factor structure. Kurtosis-KS tradeoff is fake (inv 6). K/2 AR + K/2 one-shot members should get best of both.
target: All suites — architectural diversity in ensemble
prediction: AR kurtosis + one-shot VR + combined factor diversity. Catastrophic decreases.
implementation: Dual decoder: half members through FrameDecoder, half through SinglePassDecoder. Single CRPS on combined ensemble.

name: δ: Bilateral Absolute Variance Loss
theory: Investigation 3: VR ratio loss fails (denominator inflation shortcut). Bilateral absolute target: |cum_var(h) - GT_cum_var(h)| per cell. No ratio. No asymmetry.
implementation: Precompute GT cum_var per cell per horizon. Loss = log-ratio squared (symmetric).

name: J: Copula Decomposition (Marginals + Dependence)
theory: Per-cell marginals are reasonable but cross-cell structure is rank-1. Copula separates these: model produces quantiles, copula resamples with realistic correlation.
prediction: Better cross-cell correlation without breaking per-cell quality.
implementation: Stage 1: 108a produces quantiles. Stage 2: vine/neural copula. PROXY: apply GT copula to 108a quantiles and re-evaluate.

name: ζ/K: CSDI-Style 2D Attention Denoiser
theory: CRPS has zero cross-cell AND zero cross-time gradient. CSDI 2D attention couples all cells+timesteps. Score matching loss, not CRPS. Code in external/csdi/.
target: Root cause: CRPS limitations. Different paradigm.
implementation: Adapt external/csdi/ (180 lines). PROXY: Conv3D with temporal attention replacing AdaGN.

name: O: DDPM→CRPS Two-Phase (Full Model)
theory: ECMWF approach. Phase 1: DDPM full model. Phase 2: fine-tune with afCRPS via DDIM. Gets diffusion joint distribution + CRPS calibration.
prediction: Better factor structure from diffusion + calibrated coverage.
implementation: Extend DDPM training to 30-frame. DDIM(5 steps) + afCRPS. PROXY: fine-tune existing DDPM checkpoint.

name: M: Conditional Flow Matching (replace CRPS)
theory: Flow matching learns joint distribution via ODE velocity field. Full cross-cell gradient. TSFlow (ICLR 2026). Architecture already improved factor structure with same CRPS, but FM addresses noise suppression.
implementation: Replace afCRPS with CFM loss. PROXY: one-shot Conv3D with MSE on single sample.
info_value: MEDIUM — architecture mattered more than loss

name: L: DiT (Diffusion Transformer)
theory: Full transformer encoder+decoder. 750 tokens (25 cells × 30 steps). Most Bitter-Lesson aligned. TimeDiT, DiTS show viability.
prediction: If works: scale is all you need. If fails: data floor.
implementation: PROXY: add 1-2 attention layers to Conv3D decoder first.
